ng001.m: Today, look at what you don't want to see. Everything hidden in your shadow carries a teacher.

ng002.m: Every person who disturbs you reflects something within you. Find inside what you seek outside.

ng003.m: The fire you thought had died still lives beneath the ash. One small breath is enough to make it glow.

ng004.m: The place you fear falling into is the very place your growth begins.

ng005.m: You can keep walking even when nothing is clear. The mist will lift, but you are already on the path.

ng006.m: Everything unseen is what matters most. Roots gather their strength beneath the soil.

ng007.m: The deepest voices arrive without words. Today, listen only to the silence.

ng008.m: Not every dead end is a wrong turn. It is part of the path that leads you back to yourself.

ng009.m: You have worn the mask so long it's no longer clear where your face ends and the mask begins.

ng010.m: Shedding skin is painful. But a serpent that carries its old skin cannot grow.

ng011.m: Everything passes. Your pain, your joy. Like smoke: it takes shape, then vanishes.

ng012.m: A seed beneath the soil cannot sprout without first decaying. This chaos has its meaning.

ng013.m: The moon wanes each night and fills again each month. Do not fight your cycles.

ng014.m: When you are full, nothing else can enter. Guard your emptiness: from there you create.

ng015.m: Night is not the enemy of day but its completion. Without darkness, you could not know light.

ng016.m: Standing on a bridge, you belong neither there nor here. A bridge is built to be crossed.

ng017.m: The sea whose surface is rough is still at its floor. Descend.

ng018.m: While everything changes, something within you does not. That is what carries you.

ng019.m: Truth often arrives like a flash of light. Unexpected moment, unexpected place.

ng020.m: What keeps pulling you to the same place again and again? That pull reveals something unresolved.

ng021.m: You leave a trace wherever you pass. Today, consider what kind of traces you leave.

ng022.m: Everything you say returns to you. So do the thoughts that pass through you.

ng023.m: Cutting what needs to be cut takes courage. But a sword that does not cut grows rusty.

ng024.m: Every door is both an exit and an entrance. Which side you face determines where you go.

ng025.m: Most of the chains you carry are not real. They are limits you believed in long ago.

ng026.m: Sometimes everything must collapse so the true foundation can be seen. The flood frightens but it cleanses.

ng027.m: Something has been pressed down inside you for a long time. The longer a volcano keeps its silence, the larger its eruption.

ng028.m: However deep the darkness, a star always burns within it. That star shows you home.

ng029.m: You came from earth, and to earth you return. In between, the earth feeds you, freely, quietly.

ng030.m: Dreams are not invented: they are letters from the unconscious. They are sent whether you open them or not.

ng031.m: Inspiration chooses you, not the other way around. But if you are not ready, it goes to another.

ng032.m: Prayer is not asking: it is the art of alignment. Someone who turns their voice is heard.

ng033.m: Going fast in the wrong direction is meaningless. Turning back is not weakness, it is wisdom.

ng034.m: A secret can no longer carry you. The time has come for it to open.

ng035.m: Every farewell is a small death, but seen rightly, it is a new birth.

ng036.m: Sometimes what catches fire is the thing that had been burning you all along. The fire passes; you remain.

ng037.m: The shore is where two worlds meet, land and sea. Such thresholds live in you too.

ng038.m: A mountain is not built in haste, nor brought down in haste. It simply becomes: over millions of years.

ng039.m: Sometimes to be an island, surrounded by water, on your own, is not a curse but a gift.

ng040.m: Maps outside you run out, but the compass within you does not. Only keep it from gathering dust.

ng041.m: A bell rings: and if you pretend not to hear, it rings again, louder.

ng042.m: There is a well within you, deep, dark, but with clear water at its bottom. Pass through the place where it frightens you.

ng043.m: Every person is bound to others by unseen threads. Some nourish, some pull.

ng044.m: Not everything has to be orderly. A wild garden: untended but alive: has a beauty of its own.

ng045.m: The darkest moment is the one just before dawn. Stay a little longer to see it.

ng046.m: Snow covers everything: sound, speed, mistakes. Beneath the white blanket, all begins again.

ng047.m: Shoes have made you forget the earth. Your body heals through direct contact.

ng048.m: Gratitude is the art of seeing what you have. You cannot possess what you do not see.

ng049.m: Those who stand at the threshold belong neither inside nor out. This in-between is the birth-pain of transformation.

ng050.m: What breaks does not lose its worth. The Japanese fill the cracks with gold, the broken place becomes the most beautiful.
